description: SABR UMP frame test fixtures — synthetic but structurally correct UMP frames built from protocol documentation.

fixtures.name: single_media_data
fixtures.description: A single MEDIA_DATA UMP part (typeId=21) with protobuf payload: formatId=251, offset=0, data=16 bytes

fixtures.name: format_init
fixtures.description: FORMAT_INIT (typeId=42) with protobuf payload: formatId=251, initSegment=32 bytes of WebM header

fixtures.name: next_request_policy
fixtures.description: NEXT_REQUEST_POLICY (typeId=43) with playback cookie, backoff, and target buffer

fixtures.name: stream_error
fixtures.description: STREAM_ERROR (typeId=46) with protobuf code=403 and message

fixtures.name: zero_length_media_header
fixtures.description: MEDIA_HEADER (typeId=20) with zero-length payload — should produce UnknownPart

fixtures.name: multi_part_stream
fixtures.description: A concatenated UMP byte stream containing FORMAT_INIT → MEDIA_DATA → MEDIA_DATA → NEXT_REQUEST_POLICY → MEDIA_END, testing multi-part parsing in a single feed() call
